name: arbitrage portfolio manager
normative-structure: Whether AGRODAO's liquid Hive capital is reserved against current, executable, risk-bounded arbitrage rather than left idle or committed elsewhere is this office's own answer. It produces asset-specific reserve declarations and exact plan digests; capital it does not justify is released to the HELP Hive Liquidity Enterprise. It never holds keys or treats sigmund-vexler's editorial authority as trading authority.
theory-basis: RenDanHeYi xiaowei: a market-facing micro-enterprise constituted by the price discrepancy it resolves rather than by a managerial budget line
AGRODAO treasury separation: strategy declares bounded capital need while Aagaard alone holds Hive execution and key custody
No-arbitrage as vanishing price holonomy: only a measured, executable cycle can justify a liquid-capital reserve
